name: Cartomantic
detailed_description:
It's time to change their fates. Are you ready to embark on The Fool's Journey?

  • Perform readings strategically to gain Influence, where positioning and tactical foresight can be the difference between success and failure.

  • Discover and build decks from 350+ cards inspired by both the Minor and Major Arcana.

  • Acquire 150+ build-enhancing Aspects that can make or break your Journey.

  • Encounter your fellow Major Arcana during events where they can shape your deck and alter your run.

  • Unlock true Divine power and shoulder the Burdens that come with it as you embark on endlessly replayable Journeys.

TAROT WITH A TWIST

Dive into the world of Tarot. The Minor Arcana you know and love have their own powers, from the empathetic Cups to the shrewd Swords, the invigorating Wands to the steadfast Pentacles. Start from scratch and build up your deck with each Journey! But it doesn't stop there. You will discover brand new Major Arcana suits, each with their own awesome power.

PERFORM READINGS

Each suit and rank carries unique power and meaning. Your task is to connect these mystical elements and build Influence through harmonious combinations.

BECOME WORTHY

Master the art of Tarot reading. Arcana Trials lie before you, each with its own mind bending twist. Succeed, and unlock new Aspects and Divine power. But the peak of your power only comes when you can complete every Trial in a single Journey.

COMMUNE WITH MAJOR ARCANA

The Major Arcana have the power to change the course of your run, providing you with a powerful enhancement or the potential to cut things short. Choose wisely, and accept their influence on your Journey when the moment is right.

RISING POWER

Unlock permanent upgrades and begin each new Journey stronger than before. Imbue your Cups with ability to grant you more time, manifest additional riches when you fulfill the prophecy of a Pentacles card, or enchant your Wands with the ability to appear when you need them most. With 150+ Aspects, the possibilities are endless.

GUIDE HUMANITY

As The Fool, you and the other Major Arcana have the power to decide the future of the lower planes of reality. Humanity is headed towards an untimely demise at the hands of your fellow Major Arcana, uncaring and uninterested. You may be the weakest, but you see the value in their lives. Will you rise to the challenge, complete the Arcana Trials, and gain enough power to manifest a brighter future?

short_description: Take control of fate in this Tarot roguelite deckbuilder. Wield powerful Aspects of humanity and divinity, weave explosive chain reactions, and collect hundreds of cards inspired by both Minor and Major Arcana as you journey across the higher planes in Cartomantic!
